prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once (e.g., adoption incentive, finish redesign, finish hint, home new_screen); firm rules require at least 2 tests.
Redesigns ('adoption, redesign', 'choose_path, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign') consistently hurt performance, frequently resulting in early stops or negative impacts.
'home, wait_info' and 'finish, new_screen' are helpful kinds of changes, supported by multiple winning tests.
No clear effect was consistently observed across multiple tests for 'adoption, layout', 'adoption, notification', 'choose_path, layout', 'sign_in, incentive', and 'sign_in, notification'.
Results for copy and hint changes ('choose_path, copy', 'choose_path, hint', 'adoption, hint', 'sign_in, hint') remain inconsistent, each producing occasional wins alongside non-significant or negative results.
Predictions were regularly too high for redesigns and ineffective changes, while underpredicting the magnitude of actual winning tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Control and Hide Desktop Guide Screen: Add a new dedicated screen during onboarding completion introducing desktop hotkeys, tray controls, and pet visibility toggles. (why: Support received multiple complaints from users who were confused about how to hide, control, or summon their pet after setup.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Pet Generation Fallback Creation Flow: Add an explicit fallback guidance sub-flow on photo upload providing instant preset pet styles if custom generation encounters issues. (why: Adoption drops to 62.3% and support received multiple emails about custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Engine Warmup Status Indicator: Display real-time desktop graphics engine warmup and pet sprite initialization status on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and support reported issues with pets not rendering on desktop upon launch.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion First Interaction Orientation Flow: Introduce an interactive guidance sub-flow on the final screen prompting users to click and interact with their desktop pet right away. (why: Support logged 3 emails from users unclear on how to control or talk to the pet immediately after completing onboarding.)
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Tray Launch Notification Banner: Add an explicit system notification callout on the home intro screen detailing where the system tray icon lives. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing up on desktop or app not opening after finish.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Pet Command & Control Interactive Onboarding Screen: Introduce a dedicated screen right before completion showing visual desktop pet keyboard shortcuts and tray access controls. (why: Multiple support tickets were filed regarding post-onboarding confusion around controlling and summoning desktop pets.)
6: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery and Re-login Persistence Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging into an existing account restores saved pets. (why: 8 support emails were reported regarding pets missing or account reset after signing in again.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Path Creation Time & Quick Adoption Recommendation Hint: Add a path time estimation hint clarifying setup duration and highlighting instant pet adoption options. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s despite a median of 8s, indicating some users stall on deciding.)
8: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Generation Progress Status: Display real-time processing status steps while finalizing the adoption certificate. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop in the onboarding funnel (62.3% conversion) and long mean completion times (1017s).)
9: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Permission & System Tray Readiness Counter: Add display overlay permission and system tray integration readiness status updates on the waiting screen. (why: Support received multiple reports of desktop feature misbehavior and initial launch rendering problems.)
